sources.citation: Ellen J. Langer, Arthur Blank, Benzion Chanowitz (1978). The mindlessness of ostensibly thoughtful action: The role of "placebic" information in interpersonal interaction. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology.
sources.notes: Foundational primary study (1978) in Journal of Personality and Social Psychology establishing the core experimental paradigm and quantitative parameters.

sources.citation: Valerie S. Folkes (1985). Mindlessness or mindfulness: A partial replication and extension of Langer, Blank, and Chanowitz. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology.
sources.notes: Controlled replication testing the 'placebic information' ('because I have to make copies') compliance heuristic across varying request sizes.

sources.citation: Ellen J Langer (1992). Matters of mind: Mindfulness/mindlessness in perspective. Consciousness and Cognition.
sources.notes: Ellen Langer's theoretical synthesis explaining how familiar linguistic scripts trigger automatic mindless compliance.

sources.citation: Ellen J. Langer (1989). Minding Matters: The Consequences of Mindlessness–Mindfulness. Advances in Experimental Social Psychology.
sources.notes: Ellen Langer's Advances in Experimental Social Psychology review synthesizing scripted automaticity and mindful attention.

sources.citation: Robert B. Cialdini, Noah J. Goldstein (2004). Social Influence: Compliance and Conformity. Annual Review of Psychology.
sources.notes: Comprehensive review situating Langer's automatic 'click, whirr' compliance trigger within social influence science.
